mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user takes a firing stance and presses the input again to release the beam; the move can be charged, with the current dedicated reference reporting 10% base damage and up to 30% at maximum charge. A fully charged Tri-Beam is unblockable but leaves the user exhausted for about 2 seconds; exact charge frames and current scaling remain unresolved.
